export.hint: Every planner record of your account as one private file

export.sensitive: The file contains everything, including journal and finance. Keep it somewhere safe.

state.EXPIRED: The export expired. Start a new one.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.hint: Closes your account now and erases it after a 7-day grace period
delete.unavailable: Not available: the server’s deletion policy isn’t configured for this app
delete.description: Read what happens before you continue.
delete.consequence1: You’re signed out everywhere and can’t sign in again.
delete.consequence2: After 7 days your tasks, journal, finance, files and every other record are erased.
delete.consequence3: Until then you can cancel with your password and the recovery code shown next.
delete.consequence4: Some records may be kept as required by the retention policy.
delete.acknowledge: I understand the retention policy and that this erases my data.
delete.pending: Deletion requested but not yet confirmed. Nothing is erased; this request expires at {at}.
delete.recoveryHint: You need both to cancel during the grace period. They can’t be shown again.
delete.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select the text instead.
delete.savedCode: I saved the request ID and recovery code.
delete.leaveNote: Confirming closes your account and signs you out on every device.
